text:
Maya (PM): Quick sync — SLO simulator finished for the GA traffic profile. We also have a short list of customer cutover questions that need decisions before we open GA. TL;DR: SLA floor, hypercare window, rollback triggers, and billing backstop. :eyes:
Devin (Eng): Do you have the simulator artifacts? what's the assumed tail latency and qps distribution?
Maya (PM): Link: https://internal.redwood/sims/2156 — we modeled 99th latency at 250ms target, 95th at 110ms, mixed chat+embeds workload, baseline qps 1200 with 3x burst.
Devin (Eng): OK. I skimmed results, looks like under 3x burst we hit degraded throughput at 90s sustained. Need to decide if we fail open to cheaper model or block.
Sara (Support): For hypercare — how long of a dedicated support rotation do we want after GA? 2w? 4w? Also need a clear oncall playbook for degradation vs total outage.
Kevin (FinOps): Pricing readiness: if we allow fallback to cheaper model on overload, what's the customer-facing promise? We need a billing backstop clause so customers aren't surprised. Also need expected unit cost for baseline and for degraded-mode.
Ann (Docs): I'll start a runbook template but need the exact rollback steps and canary metrics. Can someone paste the minimal shell of the rollback script and the canary gating checks?
Devin (Eng): Paste below — minimal gate we used in staging: 
```
# canary gating pseudocode
if canary_99th_latency > 300ms or error_rate > 0.5%:
    cut_traffic(percentage=100)
    promote_previous_model()
    notify(#oncall)
```
That's intentionally conservative.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-7891 (canary-failures) — link: https://incidents/7891 — auto alert on 99th > 320ms
Maya (PM): Decisions needed from this thread: 1) SLA floor: do we publish 99p latency <=300ms or 350ms? 2) Hypercare: 2 weeks with +1 dedicated support engineer, 4 weeks for full oncall overlap? 3) Rollback policy: immediate rollback on canary fail vs staged rollback? 4) Billing: explicit degraded-mode pricing + refund/backstop?
Kevin (FinOps): My vote: publish conservative SLA 350ms for initial GA, 2-week hypercare, staged rollback (canary -> 25% -> full if persists), and a clear billing backstop (credit if degraded-mode > 6 hours in a 30-day window). Need legal to sign off.
Sara (Support): Agree with 2w hypercare, but require runbook sections: escalation matrix, customer comm templates, and hotfix patch path. I'll draft templates.
Ann (Docs): I'll generate the KB/FAQ and the runbook. Can we get a short blurb for the customer-facing degraded-mode explanation? One or two sentences.
Maya (PM): Draft blurb: "If traffic exceeds burst capacity, requests may be served by a compatible, lower-latency model variant with equivalent safety and format guarantees. We monitor quality and will notify customers if degraded-mode is active for more than 1 hour." Ok to iterate.
Devin (Eng): Fine. For rollout gating, I want an automated canary simulator run in prod for first 48 hours of GA and a tooling hook to force rollback. I can add the automation.
Maya (PM): Action items: Devin - add prod-canary automation + rollback hook (owner), Ann - draft runbook & customer blurb, Sara - escalation templates and hotfix path, Kevin - finalize billing backstop language and cost buckets. Let's reconvene tomorrow 11am PT. :thumbsup:
